headline: Binance Resumes Withdrawals Following Record Cryptocurrency Hack
summary: Binance has resumed withdrawals as it tests its promise to fully reimburse clients following a major cyber theft four times larger than previous records.
why: Binance is one of the world's largest cryptocurrency exchanges, and security incidents or liquidity freezes at major platforms can impact broader digital asset market confidence.

impacts.name: Binance
impacts.why: Resuming withdrawals directly affects Binance's operations and customer trust after the security breach.
